study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled primary-prevention trial with a nested case-control baseline biomarker analysis
cohort_total_n_excerpt: These samples were assayed, according to a nested case-control design, from 1439 men subsequently diagnosed with cancer over 12 years of follow-up (631 with prostate carcinoma) and 2204 controls matched by age and smoking habits.
reason: The abstract reports incident prostate carcinoma without stage, grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal disease analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: This was primarily due to a significant reduction in the risk of prostate carcinoma (RR = 0.68, 95% CI, 0. 46-0.99) in this group.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported RR is for prostate carcinoma overall among men in the lowest baseline beta-carotene quartile, not aggressive prostate cancer.
